KuPS competes in [[Veikkausliiga]], the top flight of [[Finnish football]]. The team plays its home matches at [[Kuopio Football Stadium]]. KuPS has won eight Finnish championship titles, the [[Finnish Cup]] five times and the [[Finnish League Cup]] once.
